newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down as investors book profit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down as investors book profit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down amid profit-taking ending a long bull-run ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"Small investors cashed gains from rises over the past several sessions," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index lost 51.34 points or 4.14 percent at 1,187.84 on turnover of 91 million taka on Thursday. Losers led gainers by 106 to 25.
Aziz Pipes lost 42 taka to 1,305, Orion Infusion fell 3.89 to 143.48 and Green Delta Insurance was up 12 to 521.
